base_corner.description: Corner base unit - 1 rh or lh door, 8x8 fixed corner front panel, 2 shelves

front_layout.note: CORRECTED 2026-08-24 (learned rule 9): THE L IS 77 x 80, NOT 80 x 80. The printed 8x8 is a nominal; the leg running along the WIDTH is drawn at FILLER_MM minus FRONT_GAP_MM because it meets the neighbouring run's FRONT, which stands one gap proud of that run's carcass. A full 80 overshoots it - measured in a real kitchen, Avenida Primavera, 2026-08-24. The RETURN leg meets nothing and keeps its 80. A UCON decision, its scope recorded (learned rule 4). THE ORIGINAL NOTE FOLLOWS, and its 8x8 is still what the catalog prints. One door of 300/450/600 at the execution's end, then the 8x8 corner filler: ONE solid L, both legs 80 long and 22 thick, its front leg on the door plane and its return projecting forward so the perpendicular run meets it. The rest of the carcass front is blind. Door and filler share the front height, so door version 75 shortens both.

base_corner.notes: TWIN OF base_h78 / base_corner: same position, same wording, same shape on the H.84 page; keys carried from it, codes, elevation and glyphs re-read on the H.84 page itself. Printed rules, verbatim: W.100/105 unit with 30 cm door - 90 cm carcass; W.115/120 unit with 45 cm door - 90 cm carcass; W.130/135 unit with 60 cm door - 120 cm carcass. Rows as printed: BK090/110/125 100x43, 115x43, 130x43 (d.35); AQ090/110/125 100x70, 115x70, 130x70 (d.62); AS090/110/125 105x75, 120x75, 135x75 (d.67), each D/S. THE INTERIOR DIFFERS FROM H.78: '2 shelves' here, '1 shelf' there. Everything the H.78 twin records about execution letters, the derived door hand (Elda, estimate 2026/30831) and corner seating applies here unchanged and is not repeated - read base_h78.json base_corner.
